edge.name: content-media-sign
edge.authentication: existing handler validates user JWT; service metadata RPC remains server-only

scope: Readiness and immutable source-version metadata, not media download timing. Existing authenticated sessions and content used inside rollback transactions. No lasting tickets or content writes.
fallback: A metadata request over 500ms returns the original authorized delivery without HLS hints. Production cold function read exceeded this budget; repeat read completed within it.
